name: コクバンレイ
description: A floating rectangular blackboard creature hovering upright in the air, its dark green-black slate surface unmistakably that of a classroom chalkboard. A worn wooden frame borders its body, chipped and aged, with two stubby wooden legs dangling below like a standing easel's feet. Ghostly white chalk marks drift and swirl across its surface on their own — equations, kanji, and doodles that write themselves, smear, and rewrite in an endless spectral loop. Two large, glowing pale-blue eyes peer out from the center of the board, wide and unblinking, formed from luminous chalk circles that leave faint trailing afterimages when the creature tilts. A thin haze of chalk dust perpetually billows from its surface like breath on a cold night, and the wooden frame rattles softly as though shivering, giving the whole creature an eerie, restless presence.

name: イスロリ
description: A wooden school chair that has sprung to life, its four legs now acting as nimble limbs that skitter across classroom floors. Its seat tilts expressively like a head, and the backrest fans out into a pair of flat wooden wings that let it glide short distances. Glowing grain-line patterns pulse across its surface in pale green, hinting at the forest spirit that animates it. A mischievous creature, it loves to scuttle underfoot and trip the unwary, spinning in place with gleeful rattling sounds.

name: ツクエオン
description: A stout wooden school desk that has sprung to life, its four legs stomping about with surprising agility. Its flip-top lid opens and closes like a chattering mouth, revealing a glowing interior where notebooks and pencils rattle around like teeth. Leafy vines curl from its joints and drawer handles, hinting at the living wood within. Its surface is covered in carved protective runes that shimmer faintly green, and a small potted plant sprouts cheerfully from one corner like a crest.

name: 石の巨人
description: Less humanoid than most golems — an oversized boulder torso sits atop stubby legs, with long arms that drag near the ground like a gorilla's. Its head is just a rounded mossy rock with two deep dark eye-hollows emitting faint teal light. Ancient runes spiral across its rough unfinished surface, and ferns sprout from every crack in its joints where decades of rain have settled. It hunches in the school courtyard, tilting its head as if listening to lessons it has guarded for centuries.
